'''Passes''' ---- ''For information about Events, click [[Events|here]].'' '''Passes''', currently referred to as '''Battle Passes''' and formerly known as '''Seasons''', are a feature that allows players to unlock limited-time skins, [[emotes]] or [[crates]]. Each item has its own rank, which you can unlock by getting enough of the '''Pass''' specific [[Currencies|currency]], which is gotten from playing survival matches or [[Events|event]] maps, or by purchasing it with {{Robux|Robux}}. The '''Pass''' starts with Level 0 and with each level unlocked, you gain rewards.
